title: Critical coupling with zero-mode corrections in discretized light-cone quantized $φ^4$ theory
summary: We present an advancement for solving the Discretized Light-Cone Quantization (DLCQ) Hamiltonian for mass spectra in 2D $φ^4$ theory that incorporates perturbative zero-mode contributions. We demonstrate that this correction accelerates numerical convergence of the mass eigenstates with increasing resolution and yields a critical coupling of comparable accuracy with a substantial reduction in computational costs.
